summary: Verified build fix + Redis-backed durable state (6 operational concerns) for DynoPay. tsc --noEmit passes on both backend and frontend. 3 targeted jest suites pass (14/14). Live restart-survival flow on preview with IP 203.0.113.91 fully reproduced: 5x /api/pay/creator/wp-json -> 403, auto-block on /api/status/health -> 403, Redis keys dynopay:durable:bot:hits:203.0.113.91='5' and dynopay:durable:bot:blocked:203.0.113.91='{"since":...,"hits":5}' with TTL=3594s, backend restart -> block STILL enforced (203.0.113.91=403, 203.0.113.92=200), backend log contains '[BotProtection] Restored 1 auto-blocked IP(s) from Redis'. QA keys deleted, backend restarted, final state clean (203.0.113.91 now returns 200). Regression: preview /api/status/health=200, localhost /health=200 with database+redis connected, /api/kb/articles=200.
critical_code_review_comments: durableState helpers correctly swallow Redis errors returning null/false so middleware/services degrade to in-memory behavior — good resilience posture.

hydrateBlockedIps is called both at startup (awaited after connectRedis) and lazily in middleware; ensure the lazy path is guarded against repeated SCANs under load (observed log confirms single restore on cold start — looks fine).
test_credentials: N/A — read-only verification; no login performed (live prod DB).
seed_data_creation: Transient Redis keys dynopay:durable:bot:hits:203.0.113.91 and dynopay:durable:bot:blocked:203.0.113.91 created during the restart-survival test, then deleted; backend restarted twice (once mid-test to verify survival, once after cleanup to clear in-memory state). Final state verified clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Build fix (TS2556 in feeWalletMonitorDigest.test.ts) and Redis-backed durable state verified end-to-end on preview. The X-Forwarded-For spoof using the first entry works through the ingress — handy for future bot-protection tests. Always clean up Redis keys under dynopay:durable:bot:* after QA and restart backend to drop in-memory block set. Never issue write requests (prod DB).
rca of the issue: Build failure RCA (already fixed by main agent): __tests__/feeWalletMonitorDigest.test.ts line 7 declared `jest.fn(() => ...)` with no typed rest-arg, so later call sites spreading tuple args triggered TS2556 under tsc --noEmit in the Docker `yarn build` step and the GitHub 'backend tsc --noEmit' job. Fix: `jest.fn((..._args: unknown[]) => ...)`. Verified both tsc runs now exit 0.
